title: bunq Voice
summary: Voice-first banking for blind, sight-impaired and motor-disabled people. Built in 24 hours at bunq Hackathon 7.0.
body: bunq's security blocked screen readers, which locked out the people who most need another way in. With bunq Voice you talk to your account: check balances, review transactions and set up payments, and it speaks the answers back.
The model never moves money. Every payment it proposes becomes a pending draft that still needs biometric approval in the bunq app, so accessibility does not cost security.

Speech-to-text, Claude's reasoning and text-to-speech run concurrently, so the next sentence is already on its way while the current one plays. Built with Giuseppe Dotto, Mink Quispel and Joshua Ross.
